# On-Model Consent Copy (verbatim, for the mobile app)

> **DRAFT — not legal advice.** This file is the **single source of truth** for the consent text
> the SnapList mobile app (`apps/mobile`, screen OnModel — E6-T4) must display **before the
> first on-model render**. The app **quotes this text verbatim** (between the markers below); it
> does **not** paraphrase it. If legal copy changes, edit this file and bump the version; the app
> reads the version it shipped against.
>
> Acceptance (PLAN E9-T2): the consent states in plain language that the garment is rendered on a
> **synthetic** model, that the model image is **licensed to us**, and that **no real person's
> likeness is used**; the app shows it **before** the first render, not after.
>
> Draft prepared: 2026-11-06. Version: **1.0**.

---

## VERBATIM BLOCK — quote exactly, do not edit

```
<!-- BEGIN SNAPLIST ON-MODEL CONSENT v1.0 — DO NOT EDIT WITHOUT LEGAL REVIEW -->
Before we create your on-model shot:

• Your garment will be shown on a model image that is computer-generated (synthetic).
• The model image is licensed to SnapList for this purpose.
• No real person's photograph or likeness is used to create your on-model image.
• The on-model image is generated by AI and is for illustrating how the garment may look on a
  body. It is not a photograph of a real person wearing your item.

By continuing, you confirm you understand the above and consent to SnapList generating this
on-model image from your garment photo. You can skip this step at any time — your listing works
without it.
<!-- END SNAPLIST ON-MODEL CONSENT v1.0 -->
```

---

## Implementation guidance for E6-T4 (mobile)

- Render the text **between** the `BEGIN`/`END` markers exactly as written. Do not split, reorder,
  or reword it. Show it on the **first** on-model action for the account; thereafter you may
  surface a shorter reminder, but the full block must be shown at least once before the first
  render request is sent.
- The `vton` job must not be enqueued until the seller has acknowledged this consent (e.g. a
  one-time `on_model_consent_accepted` flag on the profile, or a signed consent event). Wire this
  to the analytics `paywall_impression` / on-model trigger only after acknowledgement.
- Keep the version string (`v1.0`) in the marker so a future legal revision can be detected.
- If the product ever enables **real-person** model references (see `docs/LEGAL.md` R2 and
  `docs/templates/model-release.md`), this copy is **insufficient** and must be revised by counsel
  — a synthetic-only statement would be inaccurate for a real likeness. Treat that as a blocking
  change, not a copy tweak.
